description: Flat metadata schema for individual records from RNA-seq and LC-MS studies of Arabidopsis thaliana under environmental stress and altered phytohormone levels, including observed causal interactions and supporting reference evidence.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record or observation.

study_id.descr: Identifier for the source study, project, or experiment batch.

species.descr: Biological species studied; expected value: Arabidopsis thaliana.

ecotype_or_accession.descr: Plant ecotype/accession used, e.g., Col-0, Ler-0.

tissue_type.descr: Plant tissue sampled, e.g., leaf, root, shoot, seedling.

developmental_stage.descr: Plant developmental stage at sampling, e.g., rosette, seedling, flowering.

growth_condition.descr: Baseline growth environment before treatment, including medium or soil context.

environmental_stress_type.descr: Type of stress applied, e.g., drought, salt, heat, cold, osmotic, pathogen, light stress.

stress_intensity.descr: Intensity or severity of the stress treatment, with units if applicable (e.g., mM NaCl, °C above baseline, % field capacity).

stress_duration_h.descr: Duration of stress exposure in hours.

stress_timepoint_h.descr: Time after stress onset when sampling occurred, in hours.

hormone_name.descr: Name of the plant hormone perturbed, e.g., ABA, auxin, salicylic acid, jasmonic acid, ethylene, brassinosteroid.

hormone_level_treatment.descr: Direction or category of hormone manipulation, e.g., increased, decreased, exogenous_application, inhibitor_treatment, mutant_background.

hormone_concentration.descr: Applied hormone concentration, in standard units such as µM, nM, or mg/L when relevant.

hormone_unit.descr: Unit for hormone concentration or dose, e.g., uM, nM, mg/L, ppm.

hormone_endogenous_level_change.descr: Observed or inferred change in endogenous hormone level relative to control, e.g., fold change or percentage; use negative values for decrease if applicable.

gene_or_transcript_id.descr: Gene or transcript identifier affected in the record, preferably TAIR locus ID or transcript ID.

gene_symbol.descr: Common gene symbol or short name, if available.

metabolite_name.descr: Metabolite name associated with the record, using standardized nomenclature when possible.

metabolite_identifier.descr: Standard metabolite identifier such as KEGG, HMDB, PubChem, or ChEBI ID.

omics_assay_type.descr: Primary measurement platform used for the record, e.g., RNA-seq, LC-MS, or combined multiomics.

expression_change.descr: Observed change in gene/transcript abundance relative to control, typically fold change or log2 fold change.

metabolite_abundance_change.descr: Observed change in metabolite abundance relative to control, typically fold change or log2 fold change.

p_value.descr: Statistical significance value for the observed change or interaction test.

adjusted_p_value.descr: Multiple-testing corrected p-value, e.g., FDR-adjusted p-value.

effect_size.descr: Quantitative effect size for the change or interaction, if reported; units depend on analysis type.

causal_interaction_direction.descr: Direction of the inferred causal relationship, e.g., hormone_to_stress_response, stress_to_hormone, gene_to_metabolite, metabolite_to_gene.

causal_interaction_type.descr: Type of causal relationship inferred, e.g., activation, repression, mediation, feedback, correlation-supported-causality.

causal_interaction_description.descr: Short textual description of the causal interaction observed or inferred between hormone signaling and stress response.

causal_evidence_level.descr: Strength or provenance of evidence supporting the interaction, e.g., direct_experiment, genetic_evidence, computational_inference, literature_supported.

evidence_method.descr: Method used to support causality, e.g., mutant analysis, overexpression, inhibitor treatment, time-series analysis, network inference, literature curation.

reference_study_id.descr: Identifier for the reference study providing supporting evidence, e.g., DOI, PubMed ID, or internal citation key.

reference_author_year.descr: Author-year citation string for the supporting study, e.g., Smith et al. 2023.

reference_title.descr: Title of the supporting publication or source study.

reference_journal.descr: Journal, repository, or source venue for the supporting study.

reference_doi.descr: Digital Object Identifier of the supporting study, if available.

reference_pmid.descr: PubMed ID of the supporting study, if available.

sample_id.descr: Identifier for the biological sample or aliquot corresponding to this record.

biological_replicate.descr: Biological replicate number for the sample.

technical_replicate.descr: Technical replicate number for the measurement, if applicable.

sample_size_n.descr: Number of biological samples represented in the measurement or summary statistic.

platform_instrument.descr: Specific sequencing or mass spectrometry instrument/platform used, e.g., Illumina NovaSeq, Orbitrap.

library_or_extraction_protocol.descr: Protocol used for RNA library preparation, metabolite extraction, or combined sample prep.

normalization_method.descr: Data normalization method used, e.g., TPM, DESeq2 size factors, TIC normalization, internal standard normalization.

quality_control_passed.descr: Whether the sample/measurement passed quality control thresholds.

notes.descr: Free-text notes on unusual experimental features, deviations, or interpretation caveats.
